searchText: <@425274498732916736> <@425279588009246720> If you don't want to change the cost of `RJUMP`, please at least rectify the misleading "This is a reduction of 2 gas, compared to JUMP and JUMPI" in EIP-4200. I don't really want to but I'm open to discuss it later. Any other open issues remains from what you reported yesterday? There's one small issue in EIP-4750 where Item 8 of the `CALLF` spec is rendered as Item 1. Will there be a breakout room this Thuraday? https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/6125 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/6126 implicit discarding of stack items (by JUMPF and RETF) seems a bit dangerous, no? first of all it's not accounted for in the gas cost (afaict). and second it makes it easy to introduce subtle bugs in user code same with RETF not halting exceptionally if it's called from the top frame - seems like it should fail loudly https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/eof1-checklist - gas costs is missing JUMPF btw Gas cost should be already in the EIP.
